title: OwnerAppLocalePreferences
description: Local JSON persistence contract for independent UI language (language_pref) and default document language (default_doc_lang) in apps/owner (FR-009).

language_pref.description: Persisted user interface language code (ar = Arabic RTL, fr = French LTR, en = English LTR).

default_doc_lang.description: Independently persisted default language code for future generated PDF contracts and receipts.
